cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "[$(date)] Waiting for Llama PID $1 (unc) and $2 (con) to finish..."

while kill -0 $1 2>/dev/null || kill -0 $2 2>/dev/null; do

    echo "[$(date)] Still waiting... Llama unc=$1 con=$2"
done
echo "[$(date)] Llama both done. Starting Qwen..."

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 nohup /root/miniconda3/bin/python run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode unconstrained --dataset docred \
    --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen_lora_docred_merged \
    --data_path data/docred/dev.json \
    --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \
    --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_qwen_docred_greedy_unc_4096.jsonl \
    --device cuda:0 --max_new_tokens 4096 --seed 42 \
    --decoding_strategy greedy --skip_on_error \
    > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_qwen_greedy_unc.log 2>&1 &
echo "[$(date)] Qwen unc started PID: $!"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 nohup /root/miniconda3/bin/python run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode full_s1 --dataset docred \
    --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen_lora_docred_merged \

    --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \

    --device cuda:0 --max_new_tokens 4096 --seed 42 \

    > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_qwen_greedy_con.log 2>&1 &
echo "[$(date)] Qwen con started PID: $!"

echo "[$(date)] All Qwen runs launched."
